title: Looking between objects

paragraphs.text: Architect’s Studio describes Kala Bhoomi as a linear arrangement of thematic courtyards around existing vegetation. Its account separates the handicraft and handloom blocks, then joins them through an arcade beside a gathering court and a stepped waterbody. This is the designer’s explanation of the plan, rather than confirmation of today’s visitor route.

After looking closely at an object, try looking at the space between objects. Where does your attention go when you leave a room? Choose a threshold you can actually see and describe it before deciding what it means. A designer’s account gives you a question to test against your own observation; it need not supply your response. Keep the building, the objects and the people who made them in conversation without treating them as the same kind of evidence.
